messages:
maria.p: Hey team — customer hit intermittent 502s last night and also saw a billing failure notice. They sent a screenshot but no IDs. Can someone paste the simplest steps we can give them to grab the correlation token from the Console and from mobile SDK logs? Also a quick curl repro to try? @sam.k @nisha.s

sam.k: Console path is easiest: Console -> Requests -> filter by customer email or time -> click the request row -> Details panel -> 'Correlation token'. Copy the full token string (it usually starts with `rwd_`). Ask them to paste the whole token, not just the tail. :+1:

sam.k: If they only have a timestamp, tell them to set the time range to ±5 minutes and search for 502 / 400 / billing in the status column.

infra-bot: Note: correlation tokens are retained for 30 days by default. If the event is older, request a debug bundle from the SDK.

nisha.s: For mobile SDKs, the quickest help text to give customers: "Enable debug logs and reproduce the error, then search logs for `corr` or `correlation`". Example snippets: 
```
# Android (Kotlin)
client.addRequestInterceptor { req ->
  Log.d("redwood", "headers=${req.headers}")
}

// look for header: X-Redwood-Correlation or x-rw-corr
```
```
// iOS (Swift)
RWIClient.shared.onRequest = { req in
  print("headers:\\(req.headers)") // look for X-Redwood-Correlation
}
```

nisha.s: Also ask them to include SDK version and exact device time (timezone). Mobile logs + correlation token + approximate incident timestamp = high-quality repro.

alex.m: Quick curl repro to paste into support reply (remind them to redact API key):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Redwood-Correlation: rwd_example123" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
alex.m: If they have a browser request, tell them to use DevTools -> Network -> right click the request -> Copy -> Copy as cURL (cmd). That gives us exact headers + body.

support-bot: Quick checklist to paste to the customer: 
• Timestamp (UTC) of the error
• Correlation token (from Console or SDK log)
• HAR / cURL or SDK logs (redact API keys)
• SDK version + platform (Android/iOS/web)
• Short repro steps and sample input

maria.p: Perfect — I'll send that checklist. If they drop the token here I can look it up and pull the server-side traces. Thanks all :heart:
